summary: Owner-approved reversible Software UI/IA release. Converts routine Software browsing from landing→purpose-card→second-level pages into one primary page with inline search, platform filters, purpose navigation, real software cards, and direct selection into the existing browser-local install profile. Legacy detail routes remain as a non-destructive compatibility path for advanced view/sort/pagination. Start canonical resources remain the only data authority. No Schema/migration, canonical data mutation, auth/security semantic change, updater mechanism change, provider/server state change, destructive action, or Production write. Production remains Owner-manual. OWNER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME=POST_RELEASE_REQUIRED; OWNER_REAL_USE=POST_PRODUCTION_REQUIRED.
